digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework — OpenAI target normalization
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs inferred or explicit openai: model targets, because v2 will reinterpret that prefix from Chat Completions to Responses.

Normalization of all rebar-owned OpenAI model construction paths (primary inference, legacy explicit, model-class fallback) from openai: to openai-chat: preserves existing Chat Completions wire semantics and eliminates the announced deprecation warning.

Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint routing (cfg.base_url builder and per-candidate override) must recognize openai-chat: as a valid provider qualifier alongside legacy openai, or endpoint injection regresses.
Canonical operator/developer examples and LLM framework contracts must migrate from openai: to openai-chat: spellings to reflect the v2-compatible normalization.
Real loopback custom-endpoint and provider-parity tests confirm that openai-chat: targets produce identical Chat Completions payloads and endpoint behavior as the current openai: implementation.
